etymologies.etymologyHTML: From continent +‎ -al.

definitions.definition: Of or relating to a continent or continents.

quote.citation: 2012, Chinle Miller, “The Tectonic Forces of the Mesozoic”, in In Mesozoic Lands: The Mesozoic Geology of Arches and Canyonlands National Parks, Kindle edition, page 34:
quote.text: Offshore to the west of the continental margin during the Early Triassic, the Sonoma highlands formed a volcanic island arc, separated from the mainland by a shallow sea that cut through western Nevada and northwestern Utah.

quote.citation: 1827, Henry Hallam, The Constitutional History of England from the Accession of Henry VII. to the Death of George II. […], volume (please specify |volume=I or II), London: John Murray, […], →OCLC:
quote.text: No former king had involved himself so frequently in the labyrinth of continental alliances.

definitions.definition: Of the mainland, as opposed to an island offshore.

quote.citation: 1846 The Parliamentary gazetteer of Ireland (A. Fullarton, Dublin) Vol.1 p.x "Introduction; Extent" :
quote.text: The outline of continental Ireland is proximately that of a rhomboid ; and, in a general view, is greatly more continuous or less indented and undulated by cuts and sweeps of the sea than the outline of continental Great Britain.

definitions.definition: Relating to, or characteristic of, continental Europe.

quote.citation: 1908, W[illiam] B[lair] M[orton] Ferguson, chapter I, in Zollenstein, New York, N.Y.: D. Appleton & Company, →OCLC:
quote.text: at Monte Carlo or some of the other Continental gambling-hells

definitions.definition: (US, historical) Of or relating to the confederated colonies collectively, in the time of the Revolutionary War.

quote.citation: 2012, Marjorie Senechal, I Died for Beauty: Dorothy Wrinch and the Cultures of Science:
quote.text: Reflecting on his long career chronicling scientists, J. G. Crowther wondered why it was that in the grand debates over the nature of light, x-rays, and cathode rays, the British opted for particles and the continentals for waves.

definitions.definition: (US, historical) A member of the Continental army.
(US, historical) Paper scrip (paper money) issued by the continental congress, largely worthless by the end of the war.
(obsolete, by extension) The smallest amount; a whit; a jot.
